howToPlay: Sandy is a Controller who uses a Sandstorm to hide allies and control the map. Use the Rude Sands Star Power to pressure enemies or Healing Winds to support teammates while staying alive with the Sleep Stimulator gadget.
gears: Pick DAMAGE and SPEED to capitalize on aggressive pushes or use EXHAUSTING STORM to better control enemy movement within the sandstorm.
trait: This brawler suits a strategic player who enjoys manipulating the battlefield and providing support through area control.
